key.name: size-mode
key.description: Controls icon size, font size, spacing, and roundness. Options: small, medium, large.

key.name: position
key.description: Where to place the workspace bar in the top panel. Options: left, center, right.

key.name: position-index
key.summary: Position index within the panel box
key.description: Index position within the chosen panel box (left, center, or right). 0 = first position. Higher values move it further along.

key.name: left-margin
key.description: Left margin in pixels for the workspace bar container.

key.name: show-icons-background
key.description: When enabled, a subtle fill is drawn behind the workspace icons. Disable for a flatter look.

key.name: focus-scale-effect
key.description: When enabled, the icon of the focused window is shown at full size while unfocused icons are slightly shrunk, with a smooth transition when focus changes.

key.name: focus-scale-reduction
key.description: Percentage by which unfocused icons are shrunk (5 = barely noticeable, 95 = nearly invisible).
